notes: Godot 4.7.2 (GL Compatibility) playable local 1–8 player horse-racing game with SD mode, combination bets, virtual opponents, system-voice announcers, photo finishes, and saved games. SPDX GPL-3.0-only (LICENSE). Original code, illustrations, and procedural mechanical/hoof/bell SFX are GPL-3.0-only. assets/audio/first_call.ogg is an unmodified U.S. Army Bands 'First Call' recording identified on Wikimedia Commons as public domain in the United States (assets/audio/NOTICE.txt). Historical payout-card numbers in data/historical_cards.json are a fan transcription with in-file provenance (no cabinet artwork). Upstream README states this is an independent project, not affiliated with Sigma Derby. project.godot has no config/icon and the repo has no icon.png (engine default at runtime). No bundled TTF/OTF. Omitted .github/. No Git LFS, no editor .godot, no keystore.
